purpose: Teach: 添削/並列/倍率/増資/商取引/仮称/用具/インプット

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、教授の添削を真摯に受け止めろ
lines.en: Ren — take your professor's feedback seriously.
lines.style: Measured authority without harshness. Direct eye contact. A brief pause after the name to let it land. The tone of someone who sees potential and is slightly disappointed it's not being seized with both hands.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。計算を並列で進めております
lines.en: Yes. I'm working on the calculations in parallel right now.
lines.style: Quiet, steady certainty. No apology in the voice. Speaking from the middle of focused work — present, not performing. A slight nervous energy underneath, like he's aware this answer matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会の倍率は年々上がっているぞ
lines.en: Ren — conference competition rates go up every year.
lines.style: Factual statement delivered with weight. Not a threat, but a fact Ren needs to understand. Slight emphasis on 「年々」 to underline the pattern. Lean forward slightly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の増資申請を準備しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm preparing the funding request application.
lines.style: Calm, methodical. The voice of someone already moving on it, not promising to start. Very slight apologetic note — aware this is also something he should have mentioned unprompted.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、商取引契約も学んでおけ
lines.en: Ren — learn commercial contract law too.
lines.style: Another directive, but softer than the last. Almost casual about it — like this one is obvious and he's slightly surprised Ren hasn't picked it up yet. Not scolding, just stating the gap.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の仮称を考えております
lines.en: Yes. I'm thinking through the working title for the paper.
lines.style: Quick affirmation, then immediately into the next task. No lag, no hesitation. The rhythm of someone juggling multiple research threads competently. Slight breathiness — energy managed but present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験用具を清潔に保て
lines.en: Ren — keep your lab equipment clean.
lines.style: Final check-in, the simplest one. Almost paternal in its ordinariness. Delivered with the finality of someone wrapping up. Low volume, no inflection — this one is non-negotiable baseline.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。多角的なインプットを取り入れます
lines.en: Yes. I'll be incorporating feedback from multiple angles.
lines.style: Closing affirmation with a touch more confidence than previous answers. The voice of someone who's been listening and learning. Slight lift at the end — a small moment of ownership over the approach.
